scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@navi/web && npm run build --workspace=@navi/bot && npm run build --workspace=@navi/worker
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,web,bot,worker "tsc -b packages/config packages/core packages/database --watch" "npm run dev --workspace=@navi/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@navi/bot" "npm run dev --workspace=@navi/worker"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@navi/web
scripts.dev:bot: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@navi/bot
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@navi/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.db:check: npm run build:shared && npm run db:check --workspace=@navi/database
scripts.db:prune-streamers: npm run build:shared && npm run db:prune-streamers --workspace=@navi/database
scripts.db:generate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate --workspace=@navi/database
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate --workspace=@navi/database
